description: Returns a playbook's rule kit. FNMA AI lender letter: the verbatim LL-2026-04, InfoSec Supplement and ECOA/Reg B/FCRA/AVM rows with citations, paginated; `next_offset` is the next page's offset, or null when the kit is complete. FHA/VA/USDA QC: the corpus registers each check area is grounded in. The kit block's fingerprint and dates identify its version. Playbook tools accept only ids and reference names, no document text; the user's P&Ps and loan files stay in their own chat.

id.description: Playbook id: one of fnma-ai-lender-letter, fha-underwriting-qc, va-loan-qc, usda-loan-qc.

offset.description: Row offset for the next page (the previous page's next_offset).
